    • run

      private static int run(String[] args) throws IOException, SQLException
      Run the application.

      A failed load is thrown, not returned: the JVM prints the stack trace and exits with code 1.

      Parameters:
      args - the command line arguments
      Returns:
      EXIT_OK, or EXIT_INVALID_ARGUMENTS when nothing was loaded because of a bad argument
      Throws:
      IOException - Exception
      SQLException - Exception

    • setupFileLogging

      private static String setupFileLogging(DatabaseType dbType) throws IOException
      Add a log file handler to the root logger, so all log output also goes to log/<timestamp>-<dbtype>.log next to the jar file.
      Parameters:
      dbType - Database type, used as part of the log file name
      Returns:
      Base name of the log file, <timestamp>-<dbtype>, shared by the run summary JSON
      Throws:
      IOException - Failed to create the log folder or log file
